profile.headline: Recent Computer Science Grad with Interest in Entry Level UX/UI Design and a Passion for Automotive Infotainment Systems
profile.summary: Energetic computer science graduate with an interest in UX/UI design. Having an engineering background helped to guide focus to automotive industry, specifically infotainment systems. Excited to use both creative and technical strengths to contribute to a team pushing the limits of technology as we understand it today. Eager and willing to learn new skills inside and out of the workplace to become a greater asset.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
-	Researched hundreds of crane incidents via the OSHA website from 2011-2020 documenting cases involving cranes made by the company
-	Analyzed and systemized the data in the spreadsheet to share general findings that led to adjustments in training clients and staff to reduce injuries
-	Created blueprints of new office space designs after physically measuring the space and merging constraints with requests from coworkers using a white board and Adobe Illustrator resulting in purchases of new furniture and configurations of the space

positions.title: Project Intern
positions.description:
-	Completed two-week internship shadowing an industrial designer learning product design processes
-	Researched batteries and designed renderings in Adobe Illustrator to develop my own multi-purposed phone charger
-	Consulted with electrical and mechanical engineers as part of the simulated design experience
-	Presented work to the company at the conclusion of internship
positions.insights: Creative Problem Solving and Adobe Illustrator

educations.fieldOfStudy: Mechanical Engineering | Electrical and Computer Engineering

honors.title: Best Graphic User Interface (GUI)
honors.description:
- As part of the Object-Oriented Design & Data Structures course, created the graphics, functionality, and basic artificial intelligence for a game similar to tic-tac-toe and competed against peers to determine the best GUI and AI in the class
- Utilized Adobe Illustrator and creativity to design intricate shapes, backgrounds, and messages imported into the program using Java resulting in winning the award for best GUI as voted by peers and the professor
- Collaborated with peer to write code in Java to anticipate human player moves and move as the computer player accordingly resulting in successful completion of that component of the project

volunteerExperiences.description: I went on a service trip to Detroit where I worked with members of Repair the World Detroit and helped with a variety of projects relating to improving life in the inner city Detroit. Subsequently, we met around various places in Columbus once a month to volunteer for other organizations such as Habitat for Humanity and the Ronald McDonald House.

projects.title: Grocer-EAZE Grocery Cart Organizer
projects.description:
-	As part of the Engineering Design, Ethics, & Entrepreneurship course, teams were created to develop and design a product
-	Collaborated with fellow engineering students to successfully bring grocery cart organizer to fruition
-	Solely responsible for all CAD design for the product we selected to create which was more than 30 hours of CAD experience
-	Led to successful completion of design renderings on time

projects.title: Workflow Management Software
projects.description:
-	As part of the Object-Oriented Design course, Scrum teams were created to develop software for a “client”
-	Assigned roles to team members and chose the Scrum master based on knowing strengths and weaknesses of peers
-	Led initial design phase by creating a wireframe using Adobe Acrobat to give the client and back-end designers a visual representation of the product
-	Handed off to back-end team that completed product delivery on time
